probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and preferentially directing light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 2 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and positioned to achieve both cooling and light transmittable surface over the bulb outer surface__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 2 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body and one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 2 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __150__ W/mK.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 2 wherein said base member comprises __a screw base or a wedge base connector closing a first end of said body__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises __a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and is disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __150__ W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and preferentially directing light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __150__ W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, __providing a plurality of integral radially extending fins on said body__, attaching a single light emitting diode to each side of said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diodes.

18. (Cancelled)
